description: Adds three types of complications. They allow you to view the time in minutes and hours to any address/coordinates via the 2GIS API. Designed for countries supported by 2GIS (primarily the CIS and South America).
changelog:
- Added chose of **what to do when clicked on complication**, by default it's **settings of complication** but you can change it to **Update ETA** instead!
- Design updated with more **Material 3 Expressive** elements!
- Added setting to change update interval! From **5 minutes to 8 hours

_Warning! To update it you need uninstall previous version! If you don't wanna lose settings do not open Smartspacer app after uninstall of previous version!_
